# Data and code for my Substack

*I dig into environmental problems using science, making theory practical, reproducible and fun.*
Environmental Scientist on a mission.

Every article comes with the data and the code behind its figures, so you can check the numbers, rebuild the figures and ask your own questions. Each article has its own folder under `weeks/`. Open it and start with its README.

| Article | Folder |
|---|---|
| Where Does Our Plastic End Up? | [`weeks/20260930-where-does-plastic-end-up`](../weeks/20260930-where-does-plastic-end-up/) |

Run any notebook in your browser with the **Open in Colab** buttons in each article's README; no installation needed.
